basis.statement: Atlas currently represents source-supported relations and load-bearing work, but the distinction between generic relation, dependence, load, and consequence is not yet intervention-grounded.

desired_consequence.statement: One bounded specimen distinguishes a merely source-supported relation from a candidate semantic-reconstruction dependence by observed consequence under an evidence-aperture perturbation.

current_obstruction.statement: Without perturbation evidence, Atlas cannot know whether a relation actually bears continuity load or is only correlated/redundant support, weakening decomposition and horizon relevance.

relevance_test.question: Would distinguishing relation from load-bearing dependence change how Atlas selects, compresses, reconstructs, or repairs work?

pressure_selection.selection_basis: A workcycle evidence edge should not acquire dependence standing merely because it exists; dependence requires observed continuity difference under a bounded perturbation.

expected_information_gain.statement: Whether withholding one exact related evidence object changes fresh-seat semantic reconstruction of the same addressed workcycle subject.

pressure_selection.application_dependency: If a bounded dependence candidate is supported, Atlas can represent dependency standing with an explicit load dimension and intervention basis rather than treating every relation as load-bearing.

success_condition.statement: Matched fresh reconstruction runs isolate one evidence-aperture perturbation and an independent evaluator can classify continuity as unchanged, degraded, lost, multi-load/confounded, or unresolved.

failure_condition.statement: The two runs differ in more than the declared evidence aperture, or the evaluator cannot localize any observed difference to the declared semantic-reconstruction load.

unresolved_condition.statement: The perturbation outcome is not sufficient to distinguish redundancy, dependence, confounding, or reconstruction noise.

unresolved_load_bearing_questions: Does the candidate evidence relation bear SEMANTIC_RECONSTRUCTION load for this exact subject and scope?

proposed_change.statement: Represent any supported local dependence as subject + dependency target + declared load dimension + scope + temporal coordinate + standing, while retaining the underlying generic relation separately.

application.withholding_basis: Requires fresh matched reconstruction and independent adjudication.

consequence_observation.expected_effect: Future Atlas decomposition can distinguish relation existence from intervention-supported load-bearing dependence.

basis_reconciliation.remaining_gap: No bounded intervention evidence yet distinguishes relation from dependence.

if_this_work_succeeds.what_changes_in_the_operating_world: Atlas gains an evidence-based rule for whether a relation should influence reconstruction/decomposition as a load-bearing dependency, reducing arbitrary task relevance and false topology weight.
